decisions.reason: Increasing spacing between paragraphs on content-heavy pages does not resolve or change the uncertain image and text composition of the interior title page.
The paragraph-spacing decision does not change chapter illustration placement, size, quality, or assignment; the image problems in the same message are separate observations.
The source does not change the copyright-page publisher line or specify that the requested paragraph spacing applies to that page.
Paragraph spacing and page density are independent of the same message's separate requirement to italicize Mama's Hot Take text.
The spacing request does not alter table-of-contents page numbering or its update timing.
Adding space between paragraphs does not change Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, line roles, or capitalization.
The interior paragraph-spacing decision is unrelated to the prohibition on a literal newline artifact in the book title.
The source does not change the required back-matter content or author copy.
The spacing request does not change which manuscript file is authoritative or the requirement to preserve client edits; those are addressed by a separate clause.
The request concerns paragraph spacing on interior content-heavy pages and does not alter paperback cover design or cover metadata.
Interior paragraph spacing has no necessary effect on KDP keyword content or its delivery format.
The source changes visual spacing and page density, not manuscript wording, approved passages, or the copyediting goal.
